# Orion

> Orion is a high-performance declarative runtime for microservices, AI agent tools, business rules, event processing, and webhook data ingestion. Logic is declared as JSON specifications and exposed through channels (REST endpoints or Kafka topics) via an administrative REST API, which orion-cli also serves as MCP tools. Rate limiting, circuit breaking, caching, payload validation, versioning, and observability are managed directly by the runtime. Written in Rust; single executable binary with embedded SQLite by default (PostgreSQL/MySQL optional).

Key facts: workflows are pipelines of tasks using JSONLogic; everything is created as a draft, tested via dry-run, then activated (the engine hot-reloads); active versions are immutable; connectors are named connections to external systems (HTTP, SQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, Kafka) referenced from tasks by name. The full documentation concatenated into one file is at https://docs.goplasmatic.io/llms-full.txt


## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/introduction.html): what Orion is, why it exists, and where to start
- [Architectural Characteristics](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/characteristics.html): the capability map — eight characteristics, what the runtime provides under each, and the deliberate gaps
- [Is Orion Right for You?](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/comparison.html): the one chart of neighbouring tools, where Orion fits, and where it is the wrong tool
- [Install & Run](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/getting-started/install.html): install matrix for server and CLI, first run, health check
- [Your First Service](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/getting-started/first-service.html): workflow + channel end-to-end, in four API calls
- [Your First Connector](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/getting-started/first-connector.html): PostgreSQL + the portable data dialect
- [Test & Promote a Service](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/getting-started/test-and-promote.html): lint, dry-run with stubs, regression cases, then export/plan/apply to a second instance
- [Run the Examples](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/getting-started/examples.html): the deployable example packages, with the step-by-step walkthrough
- [The Console (Orion UI)](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/getting-started/console.html): no-code UI over the admin API

## Compare

- [Orion vs Durable Execution Engines](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/compare/durable-execution.html): Temporal, Restate, Step Functions, Airflow — resume vs answer-and-forget, and why weight is not the distinction
- [Orion vs API Gateways](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/compare/api-gateways.html): Kong, Envoy, APISIX, KrakenD — the gateway polices, Orion terminates; what to keep on each side
- [Orion vs Automation Platforms](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/compare/automation-platforms.html): n8n, Zapier, Make, Node-RED — app catalogue and speed vs production request traffic
- [Orion vs Rule Engines](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/compare/rule-engines.html): Drools, OPA, GoRules — inference over accumulating facts vs conditions over one payload
- [Orion vs Embedding dataflow-rs](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/compare/dataflow-rs.html): library or runtime — custom Rust handlers vs everything Orion adds around the engine

## Concepts

- [How Orion Works](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/how-orion-works.html): the three primitives, one request's journey, sync vs async, dev vs prod topology, extension surface
- [Channels](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/channels.html): service endpoints — protocols, sync/async, ingress guards, in-process composition
- [Workflows](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/workflows.html): task pipelines, the data context, conditions, how a version is selected
- [Connectors](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/connectors.html): named external connections, secrets by reference, operation gates, circuit breakers
- [Packages](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/packages.html): the module boundary — tags, closure, artifacts, receipts, rollback
- [The Entity Lifecycle](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/lifecycle.html): draft/active/archived, immutability, what reloads the engine, quarantine

- [Production Checklist](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/production-checklist.html): every pre-go-live setting, with the page that owns each

- [Cluster Mode & High Availability](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/cluster.html): requirements, what is shared vs per-node, migrations as a deploy step, sizing
- [Secure an Instance](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/security.html): admin auth, data-plane auth, TLS, trusted proxies, secrets, SSRF, origins
- [Monitoring & Alerts](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/monitoring.html): logging, Prometheus, OTLP, health endpoints, what to alert on
- [Traces & Async Processing](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/traces.html): trace storage modes, the async queue, the DLQ, retention
- [Timeouts, Retries & Circuit Breakers](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/failure-handling.html): the four timeout levels, the HTTP-only retry rule, breakers, graceful shutdown
- [Promote Between Environments](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/promotion.html): the five package verbs, receipts, secrets, mid-apply failure modes, rollback
- [Back Up & Restore](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/backup-restore.html): per-backend backup, the offline restore procedure, package artifacts as estate backup
- [Audit Logs](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/audit-logs.html): filtering, change context, retention, dropped-event alerting
- [Upgrades](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/upgrades.html): the standing upgrade procedure, preflight first, how a renamed key fails by surface
- [Upgrading to 1.1.0](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/upgrading-to-1.1.html): the five 1.0.x → 1.1.0 behaviour changes, including the rate-limit key that now refuses instead of collapsing every caller into one bucket
- [Upgrading to 1.0.0](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/upgrading-to-1.0.html): every 0.3.0 → 1.0.0 break, grouped by type, with the preflight scanner that finds them
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/troubleshooting.html): symptom-indexed fixes — quarantine, degraded health, 429s behind a proxy, open breakers, DLQ, Kafka lag, empty context

- [Connector Types](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/connectors.html): per-type field tables, secret references, operation gates, retries, masking, breakers
- [Portable Data Dialect](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/data-dialect.html): backend-neutral query/write envelope across SQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
- [Configuration Reference](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/configuration.html): every setting, default, and ORION_* environment variable
- [Metrics Reference](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/metrics.html): every exported series, its type and labels
- [Errors & Response Envelopes](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/errors.html): the admin and data envelopes, every error code, verbose_errors
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/cli.html): every orion-server and orion-cli subcommand
- [Design Notes](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/design-notes.html): the reasoning behind dedup, cache keys, hot reload, the guard pipeline
- [Support & Compatibility](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/support.html): versioning policy, what 1.0 freezes, MSRV, platform matrix
- [Glossary](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/glossary.html): one-line definitions of the load-bearing vocabulary
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec (raw)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoPlasmatic/Orion/main/docs/openapi.json): machine-readable API description
